text:
Emma R.: Quick thread 1000 - winners for the Spark microgrants are announced next Tuesday. Were doing a tiny IRL pickup + a virtual check-in for remote folks. Need volunteers to run the pickup table, someone to manage sign-in, and a remote gift routing plan. Who's in? :tada:

Carlos V.: I can run the pickup table (NYC) 11:3012:30. Do we need a table booking?

Facilities Bot: Meeting space request: Booked "Lobby Table B" for Tue 11:00-13:00. Please confirm AV needs if any.

Emma R.: Thanks Facilities Bot. No AV. Just name list + envelopes. Priya can you prep envelopes with winners' names + microgrant code slip?

Priya S.: Yep, I'll print name labels. How many winners?

Emma R.: 18 winners total: 12 in-office, 6 remote. Budget: $350 for envelopes & small token cards. Keep receipts for /expense (project=Culture, code=SPRK-MG).

Zoe N.: I'll handle sign-in and make a short scheduled slide to show the winners (2 slides). Can Marketing Ops grab a photographer for a few candids?

Marketing Ops: Happy to send a photographer for 20-30 minutes. Also can create a social-safe image pack (no home addresses). Please confirm winners ok with public photo.

Ben H.: Heads-up: a couple winners are contractors; legal says contractors eligible but we need to note payment method. Lee T. from HR confirmed earlier, but flagging.

Emma R.: Good catch Ben. HR Ops Bot, can you confirm the contractor payout flow?

HR Ops Bot: Contractors: distribution should be a non-cash token (gift card) with vendor on file. Submit payment request via /vendor-pay with tag SPARK-CTOR. Allow 5-7 business days.

Carlos V.: For remote winners, I can pack kits Wed morning and drop at shipping by 2pm. Priya, can you send the final winner sheet by EOD Mon with addresses (PMs only)?

Priya S.: Will do. Also, accessibility note: one winner uses assistive tech; please make sure the printed card has high-contrast text.

Emma R.: A11y noted and will print high-contrast. Also can we include a short "what we loved about your project" note handwritten? Small ask but personal.

Ben H.: I can do a first pass of short lines for 6 winners; others can add 1-2 sentence notes.

Zoe N.: I'll coordinate handwritings. Volunteers: please add your name to the sheet if you can write a note.

Priya S.: Sheet link: https://go.redwood/sheets/spark-microgrants 1000 - fill in 'can write note', 'office/remote', 'shipping address'.

Marketing Ops: Quick consent form for photos: please collect written OK (checkbox on the sign-in sheet).

Emma R.: Logistics timeline in brief:

```text
Mon EOD - final winner sheet from Priya (addresses + who writes notes)
Tue 9am - Priya prints labels & cards (HQ print room)
Tue 11:00 - Table set-up (Facilities)
Tue 11:30-12:30 - Pickup window (Carlos + volunteers)
Wed 10am - Remote kits packed & shipped (Carlos)
Within 7 days - submit expenses (project=Culture, code=SPRK-MG)
```

Carlos V.: Need 2 volunteers for pickup. @Ben @Zoe?

Ben H.: I can do 11:30-12:00.

Zoe N.: I can do 12:00-12:30 then help with note-writing after.

Emma R.: Amazing. Final requests: volunteers who write cards, please use black pen only. And please do not include personal addresses in any shared comms. I'll post a short reminder in #general Mon morning. :sparkles:
